Description_EN:
Enjoy a refreshing or warm shower in your garden or backyard with Parkside's eco-friendly solar shower. The integrated 18-liter tank heats the water exclusively through solar radiation, reaching temperatures up to 60°C, which you can monitor at any time using the built-in thermometer.

It features a large Ø 15 cm shower head in an elegant chrome finish, a mixer tap for easy one-handed temperature adjustment, as well as a separate, low tap for rinsing feet. Its construction is weather and UV-resistant, and it splits into 2 sections with a screw mechanism (bayonet lock) for easy transport and storage. It connects directly to all standard garden hoses thanks to the Parkside quick-connect system.
Tech_Specs_EN: Tank Capacity: 18 Liters (Maximum water temperature 60°C) | Maximum Operating Pressure: 4 bar | Shower Height: approx. 226 cm (Body diameter: 11 cm) | Smart Features: Non-return valve (to prevent water drainage if the hose is disconnected) and a drain valve for winter emptying. | Includes: Stable base (15.5 x 15.5 cm) and all necessary mounting hardware.

Description_EN: Durable and practical 10-meter extension cable (power strip cord) by Parkside, ideal for easily reaching every corner of your workshop, garage, or home. It features a connection plug with a special rubber protective cover for enhanced safety during use. It is suitable for indoor use, as well as temporary/short-term outdoor use.
Tech_Specs_EN: Length: 10 m | Maximum Power: 3680 W | Protection Rating: IP44 (splash-proof) | Plug Type: With protective rubber cover

Title_EN: Submersible Clean Water Drainage Pump PETPK 400 B2 400W
Description_EN: Reliable 400W submersible drainage pump by Parkside, ideal for pumping, emptying, and transferring clean or slightly dirty water (with solid particles up to 5 mm). It features a powerful, long-lasting motor with built-in thermal overload protection and a ceramic mechanical seal. It is equipped with an adjustable float switch for automatic activation/deactivation and dry-running protection. Its durable housing includes an ergonomic handle for easy transport, while the Quick Connect system allows for rapid connection of various hose sizes.
Tech_Specs_EN: Power: 400 W | Delivery Capacity: max. 10000 l/h | Delivery Head: max. 7 m | Immersion Depth: max. 7 m | Maximum Particle Size: 5 mm | Water Temperature: max. 35 °C | Cable Length: 10 m | Connectors: G1½" Quick Connect angled adapter - G1" adapter for hoses 13mm (1/2"), 19mm (3/4"), 25mm (1"), 38mm (1½") | Includes: 8m nylon rope, angled connector, adapter with non-return valve | Note: Unsuitable for saltwater or continuous operation (e.g., fountains)

Description_EN: Practical 5-liter pressure shoulder sprayer by Parkside, ideal for multiple uses in the garden, plot, or household. It is excellent for spraying plants, fertilizing, or protecting them. It offers comfortable and flexible operation thanks to the kink-resistant hose connection, the ergonomic handle with an integrated switch, and the included shoulder strap for easy transport. It features a spray lance made of durable fiberglass, a safety valve for pressure relief, and a transparent container with a filling scale to easily monitor the liquid level. The water flow is fully adjustable, allowing you to choose from a fine mist (spray) to a full jet stream.
Tech_Specs_EN: Usable Capacity: 5 L | Operating Pressure: max. 2.5 bar | Burst Pressure: 5 bar | Lance Material: Fiberglass | Protection: Safety pressure valve & UV radiation resistance | Includes: Shoulder strap, Filling filter, Hose storage slots

Description_EN: Powerful 550W electric lawn trimmer by Parkside, ideal for lawn maintenance and precise grass cutting in hard-to-reach areas, corners, and edges. It features a 6-position tilting cutting head and a rotating trimmer head for excellent results along the edges of sidewalks or flowerbeds. Operation is comfortable and tailored to your height thanks to the adjustable telescopic shaft (up to 29 cm) and the adjustable secondary handle. It is equipped with a dual-line system with automatic tap & go adjustment, a safety guard with an integrated line cutter, and a fold-out flower guard bar to protect your plants.
Tech_Specs_EN: Power: 550 W | Cutting Diameter: 30 cm | Line Thickness: 1.4 mm | Line Length: 2 x 5 m (per spool) | Cutting Head: 6-position tilting & rotating | Telescopic Shaft: Adjustable by 29 cm | Trimmer Line System: Dual line with automatic adjustment and tool-free spool replacement | Safety: Guard with flower protection bar & Cable strain relief mechanism

Description_EN: Smart and fully autonomous solar drip irrigation system by Parkside, ideal for caring for up to 20 plants in planters, flowerbeds, and pots while you are away from home. It operates without electricity or a tap connection, as it utilizes a solar panel and an integrated water container with a lid to prevent evaporation. The control unit features 14 preset watering programs with convenient LED indicators, while the spacing of the drip nozzles is easily adjustable by cutting the flexible hose to your preferred length. The solar panel can be mounted either on top of the unit or directly into the ground using the special ground spike.
Tech_Specs_EN: Watering Capacity: Up to 20 plants | Programs: 14 selectable time intervals | Power Supply: Solar panel & 3x rechargeable NiMH AA 1200 mAh batteries (included for operation during cloudy weather) | Waterproof Rating: IPX4 (splash-proof) | Suitable for: Flower pots, planters, balconies, greenhouses | Additional Features: Sliding micro-component compartment, Water container with lid, LED operation indicator

Description_EN: Set of 3 replacement trimmer spools (line spools) by Parkside, suitable for easily replacing and renewing the cutting line on your lawn trimmer. They are available in two different versions depending on your device model: one version is compatible with the PERT 550 trimmers and the cordless PRTA 20-Li, while the second one (PRTS 4 C1) is compatible with the PERT 300 electric trimmer. An ideal accessory to always keep a backup supply during your gardening work.
Tech_Specs_EN: Quantity: 3 pieces per package | Version 1 (For PERT 550 / PRTA 20-Li): Line thickness 1.4 mm - Length 2 x 5 m per spool | Version 2 (Model PRTS 4 C1 for PERT 300): Line thickness 1.6 mm - Length 1 x 4 m per spool | Use: Replacement cutting consumables

Title_EN: Electric Shredder / Wood Chipper PEMH 2400 B2 2400W
Description_EN: Powerful 2400W electric shredder by Parkside, equipped with a high-performance Turbo-Power motor, ideal for easily shredding branches and bushes with a thickness up to 40 mm. It features two quality blades made of specially hardened steel and an electronically controlled smooth start (soft start). For your maximum safety, it integrates overload protection and a restart safeguard in case of power interruption. It is extremely easy to transport thanks to its lightweight design and durable wheeled chassis, while it includes a practical removable 40-liter collection bag and a special plunger for pushing residues.
Tech_Specs_EN: Power: 2400 W | Motor: Turbo-Power with electronic Soft Start | Maximum Branch Thickness: 40 mm | Bag Capacity: 40 L | No-load Speed: 4500 min⁻¹ | Cutting System: 2 blades made of special hardened steel | Safety: Overload protection & Restart protection | Includes: 1 collection bag, 1 pusher with its mount, 1 Torx wrench, 1 hex key, Cable strain relief mechanism

Description_EN: Portable and cordless 4V metal detector (pinpointer) by Parkside, ideal for precisely locating small metallic objects such as jewelry, coins, and keys. It offers 360° all-around detection and can be successfully used in sand, grass, soil, and rocks, both indoors and outdoors. It features an IP68-certified waterproof and dustproof housing, a built-in LED light for dark spots, and a smart alarm system with sound, light, and vibration that intensifies as you get closer to the object. It charges easily via a USB port.
Tech_Specs_EN: Voltage: 4 V | Detection: 360° All-around | Measuring Range: Adjustable in 3 levels (20 / 40 / 60 mm) | Maximum Detection Depth: 60 mm (for a minimum object size of 25 x 2 mm) | Protection Rating: IP68 (Fully waterproof & dustproof) | Notification: Sound, visual alarm, and vibration | Operating Temperature: -10 to +50 °C | Includes: 1 spiral retaining lanyard with 2 safety snap hooks, 1 belt holster, 1 USB charging cable

Description_EN: Classic and comfortable short-sleeved T-shirt featuring the authentic Parkside logo. It is made from 100% pure, high-quality cotton, offering exceptional comfort and a soft feel against the skin. Thanks to its highly elastic material, it ensures absolute freedom of movement, making it ideal both for work in the workshop and for your daily routines. It features a crew neck and comes in a straight, comfortable fit that suits every body type.
Tech_Specs_EN: Material: 100% Pure cotton | Available Colors: Grey, Black, Green | Available Sizes: S (44/46) to XXL (60/62) | Fit: Straight / Comfortable (Regular fit) | Features: Crew neck, Large PARKSIDE logo

Description_EN: Anatomical shoe insoles with a special gel layer by Parkside, designed to offer ideal shock absorption and effectively relieve pressure on feet and joints throughout the day. They feature a soft fabric surface for a pleasant and comfortable fit, preventing sweating. They are unisex, suitable for both men and women, and make the perfect addition to work boots, athletic shoes, or everyday footwear.
Tech_Specs_EN: Material: Gel layer with fabric lining | Available Colors: Black, Khaki | Available Sizes: 38/39, 40/41, 42/43, 44/45 | Quantity: 1 pair per package | Properties: Joint relief, Shock absorption, Unisex design

Description_EN: Durable work socks by Parkside, specially designed to offer premium comfort and endurance during your work. They are made from a high-quality cotton blend for a soft feel, while thanks to the special LYCRA® fiber, they retain their shape perfectly and offer an ideal fit without slipping. They feature a reinforced toe and heel area for maximum wear resistance, making them ideal for use with work shoes or boots.
Tech_Specs_EN: Quantity: 3-pair set (3 pairs per package) | Material: Cotton blend & LYCRA® fiber for shape retention | Available Colors: Grey, Black | Available Sizes: 39-42, 43-46, 47-50 | Features: Reinforced heel & toe area

Title_EN: Cordless & Electric Portable Cool Box / Refrigerator PKB 20-Li A2 20V
Description_EN: Smart 20V portable cool box / refrigerator by Parkside, designed for maximum flexibility as it can operate in 3 ways: with a Parkside 20V rechargeable battery, via a standard home wall outlet, or through a car cigarette lighter socket (12V). It offers fast, uniform cooling as well as a keep-warm function, making it ideal for camping, road trips, the car, or the job site. It features a durable housing with extra-thick insulating walls, a special rubber sealing gasket to reduce condensation, and quiet operation (just 34 dB in ECO mode). The practical fold-away handle locks the lid, while a built-in bottle opener is included on the side. Note: Battery and charger are not included in this version.
Tech_Specs_EN: Power Supply: Parkside 20V Battery (X 20 V Team) / 230V Mains Socket / 12V Car Cigarette Lighter | Functions: Cooling & Keeping Warm | Noise Level: 34 dB (in ECO mode) | Energy Class: E (according to EU regulation 2019/2016) | Cooling Unit: Maintenance-free | Additional Features: Integrated bottle opener, Cable storage compartment in the lid, Fold-away locking handle | Note: Battery and charger are not included

Description_EN: Robust 450W bench pillar drill by Parkside, ideal for high-precision drilling in wood, metal, and plastics. Equipped with a durable induction motor and a belt drive with 5 adjustable speed settings (500–2600 min⁻¹). It features an adjustable drilling depth with a clear scale, as well as a drilling table that is height-adjustable and tilts up to 45° on both sides. For maximum safety, it integrates an emergency stop switch on the front, automatic shut-off when the gear casing is open, and a fold-out transparent guard. Its solid base features holes for secure mounting onto your workbench.
Tech_Specs_EN: Connected Load: 450 W (S6 40%) / 350 W (S1) | Speed: 500–2600 min⁻¹ (5-level adjustment) | Drilling Depth: 0–50 mm | Chuck Type: Geared B16 (1.5–13 mm) | Maximum Drilling Diameter: 25 mm in wood - 10 mm in steel | Table Tilt Angle: -45° to +45° | Vice Clamping Width: up to 75 mm | Cable Length: 1.8 m | Includes: 1 machine vice, 1 chuck key, 2 hex keys (4 mm, 10 mm)

Description_EN: Versatile and powerful 20V cordless angle grinder by Parkside (G4 version), ideal for cutting and grinding metal, concrete, or tiles when using the appropriate discs. It features electronically adjustable speed controls for absolute precision depending on the work material, as well as a non-slip, soft grip handle that can be mounted in 3 different positions. It comes equipped with a 2-in-1 protective guard (for cutting and grinding) featuring a tool-free quick-adjustment system, and offers easy disc changes thanks to the automatic spindle lock (Spindle Lock). Its rubberized housing is combined with a durable aluminum front head for a long service life. Note: Battery and charger are not included in the package.
Tech_Specs_EN: Voltage: 20 V | No-load Speed: 2500–11000 min⁻¹ (Adjustable) | Maximum Disc Diameter: 125 mm | Spindle Thread: M14 - Spindle Lock | Compatibility: All batteries in the "X 20V TEAM" series | Recommended Battery: 20V (4 Ah) | Includes: 1 metal cutting disc Ø 125 mm (pre-installed), 1 disc change wrench | Features: 3-position handle, 2-in-1 protective guard, Aluminum front head

Title_EN: Screwdriver Bit and Accessory Set (2 Options)
Description_EN: Practical and ergonomic screwdriver sets by Parkside, designed for comfortable operation and quick bit changes in the workshop or at home. They feature easy-to-read laser-marked size indicators and are available in two different versions to choose from: [A] a 21-piece set featuring a screwdriver, 10 bits, and 10 sockets in a practical storage case, or [B] a 6-piece ratchet screwdriver set with 5 specialized double-ended bits (including Torx, Phillips, and slotted/flathead types).
Tech_Specs_EN: Ergonomic handle, Laser marking | [Version A] Socket Set (21 pcs.): 1 Screwdriver, 10 Bits (PH1, PH2, PH3, PZ1, PZ2, PZ3, SL3.0, SL4.0, SL5.5, SL6.0), 10 Sockets (4 to 13 mm), Practical case | [Version B] Ratchet Set (6 pcs.): 1 Screwdriver with ratchet function, 5 Double-ended bits (PH1/PH2, T10/T15, T20/T25, SL5.0/SL6.0)

Title_EN: Large Socket and Bit Wrench Set (216 Piece Case)
Description_EN: The comprehensive 216-piece professional tool case by Parkside is the ultimate set for any workshop, garage, or demanding work environment. It includes a massive variety of heavy-duty ratchets, sockets, combination wrenches, and bits, suitable for all types of mechanical work and repairs. All components feature a premium matte finish and highly legible size markings thanks to laser-etching technology. It comes in an ultra-durable, organized carrying case with metal latches, where every tool has its own designated slot.
Tech_Specs_EN: Quantity: 216 pieces | Finish: Matte (Chrome Vanadium / high-quality steel) | Marking: Laser-marked sizes | Includes: Ratchets (1/2", 3/8", 1/4"), Sockets (short and deep), Combination wrenches, Extensions, Universal joints, Wide variety of bits (Torx, Hex/Allen, Phillips, Slotted) | Packaging: Sturdy plastic case for organized storage

Title_EN: Rotary Tool - Grinding and Drilling Device PFBS 160 D3 160W
Description_EN: Multifunctional 160W precision rotary tool by Parkside, ideal for drilling, milling, engraving, polishing, cleaning, or cutting. It features a powerful motor with electronically adjustable speed settings (10000–40000 min⁻¹) and an ergonomic design with a non-slip grip. It comes with a flexible drive shaft for high-precision work, a telescopic stand with a bench clamp, and adjustable LED lighting. Bit changes are quick and easy thanks to the spindle lock (Spindle Lock), while the entire set comes organized in a practical storage case.
Tech_Specs_EN: Rated Power: 160 W | No-load Speed: n 10000–40000 min⁻¹ (Adjustable) | Collet Diameter: Ø 2.4 mm / Ø 3.2 mm (pre-installed) | Cable Length: 4 m | Features: Spindle lock, LED lighting, Non-slip grip | Includes: 1 flexible shaft, 1 telescopic stand with clamp and hanging hook, 1 router attachment, 42-piece accessory case, batteries for the LED, carrying case

Description_EN: Versatile 4-in-1 cordless garden multi-tool featuring a powerful, maintenance-free brushless motor, perfect for complete outdoor property care. It allows for quick, tool-free attachment changes, combining a lawn trimmer, brush cutter, hedge trimmer, and pole saw into a single device. Designed for effortlessly clearing lawns and undergrowth, it also enables safe tree and hedge trimming directly from the ground, reaching a working height of up to approximately 3.5 meters.
Tech_Specs_EN: Voltage: 40 V | Motor: Brushless, maintenance-free, with up to 30% longer run time compared to conventional motors | Functions: 4-in-1 (Lawn trimmer, Brush cutter, Hedge trimmer, Pole saw) | Lawn Trimmer: Double-filament spool with automatic filament feed, cutting diameter approx. 30cm | Brush Cutter: Robust 3-edge steel blade, cutting diameter approx. 25cm | Hedge Trimmer: Laser-cut special steel blade, cutting length approx. 41cm, maximum cutting thickness approx. 1.5cm, tool-free adjustable working angle in 7 steps (-45° to +90°) | Pole Saw: High-quality guide bar and durable chain, cutting length approx. 18cm, automatic chain oiling system, 5-step adjustable working angle (0°-90°) | Comfort Features: Charge status display on tool, ergonomic handle with soft grip, additional adjustable handle with leg protection, comfortable double shoulder harness with hip protection and quick-release system | Includes: 1 double shoulder harness, 1 chain guard, 1 blade guard, 1 transport guard (for 3-blade knife), assembly tool, 100ml organic saw chain oil | Compatibility: All batteries in the "X 20 V TEAM" series | Recommended Batteries: 2x 20V (4Ah) – This tool strictly requires 2 batteries for operation | Note: Bare unit - batteries and charger are not included
